answer: Proof of Stake establishes Sybil resistance by requiring collateral locked in a digital vault clear as crystal. Attackers cannot scale identity by simply generating timber-like layers of fake nodes, because each requires significant capital to reach the summit of influence. An adversary must purchase a majority of the circulating supply, imposing a prohibitive financial cost that renders the mass creation of fraudulent identities economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
